section_summary.extract_value: The section reports results from a mixed-design experiment using SBAS-2 state body appreciation scores, comparing high vs low acceptance situations and sex. Means are reported separately by sex for high (men 3.79, women 3.72) and low (men 2.76, women 2.38) acceptance situations, and a mixed ANOVA (F(1,103)=215.88, p<.001) showed a large main effect of situation but no significant sex main effect or interaction. No other sample demographics, country, BMI assessments, or correlations with BMI are reported in this text.
section_summary.evidence_source: Quoted sentences: "For men, mean state BA was 3.79 (SD=0.73) for high acceptance situations and 2.76 (SD=0.97) for low acceptance situations. For women, mean state BA was 3.72 (SD=0.86) for high acceptance situations and 2.38 (SD=0.92) for low acceptance situations." and "A mixed design factorial ANOVA ... showed a significant main effect for situation, F(1,103)=215.88, p<.001, ... a nonsignificant main effect for sex, F(1, 103) = 2.17, p = .14, ... and a nonsignificant interaction between situation and sex, F(1, 103) = 3.67, p = .06."
